Column {data-width=600}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Feature Comparison

```{r}
# You can include more complex analysis here
features_df <- bind_rows(
  extract_features("features/erik-l-1.json") %>% mutate(source = "AI Piano"),
  extract_features("features/erik-l-2.json") %>% mutate(source = "Für Elise")
)

# Create a comparison plot
ggplot(features_df, aes(x = source, y = danceability, fill = source)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Danceability Comparison", x = NULL, y = "Danceability Score") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Paired")
```

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Correlation Analysis

```{r}
# Example correlation analysis
corr_plot <- features_df %>%
  select(bpm, danceability, loudness, onset_rate) %>%
  cor() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("feature1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-feature1, names_to = "feature2", values_to = "correlation") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = feature1, y = feature2, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Feature Correlation Matrix") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

corr_plot
```
